answer: A water-share bid at oasis Station 4 opens only after a claimant parks a 380-liter cistern at inlet gate C-9 by 05:44 and hangs 16 leaf-wetness probes along the east trellis at 1.25 m spacing. Each probe must report a 3-byte humidity hash that matches the cistern's sealed log within 11 millibar and 0.4 °C. Three independent loggers plus a 4.8 kHz acoustic ping have to agree inside 70 seconds; a split reading, or a second cistern at the same gate within 9 hours, forfeits 28 percent of the 8,200-unit bond and bars that claimant from the next 6 allotments.
